goal: Determine whether bounded search, reuse, composition, qualified candidate creation, and later reuse produce real capability internalization without changing production authority.
acceptance_criteria: classify capability and non-capability gaps before proposing growth
enforce reuse before bounded composition before creation
implement candidates through the existing sandboxed capability builder and hidden qualification
admit only qualified candidates to independent experimental registry clones
freeze one 100-task stream and run G0, G1, G2, and G3 on one clean Source Closure
measure internalization, saturation, debt, strong context compression, usage, cost, and latency without changing production routing

quality_metrics.method: hidden expected labels over the frozen stream

quality_metrics.measure: later tasks using previously admitted capabilities
quality_metrics.target: reuse and composition grow while creation declines
quality_metrics.method: derived per-task experience ledger and 20-task windows

strong/cheap calls, tokens, cost, latency, and compressed context

prevention: hidden fixtures excluded from Provider context
control: no force push or automatic PR
improvement: compare G1 debt with G2 composition-first behavior
retain Strong abstraction decisions only if G3 improves outcomes

interface_expectations: CapabilityRegistry remains the sole capability authority
experimental registries are isolated deterministic clones
composition plans are ephemeral and use the existing Runtime boundary
production routing, Knowledge, persistence, validation, and delivery authorities remain unchanged

feedback: G2 search-compose-create reached 99 percent success with 15 admitted capabilities and zero zero-use debt.
G3 matched success but increased cost and debt; the strong growth decision layer is harmful on this frozen stream.
Keep production capability authority and fixed routing unchanged until precision and repeated external validation improve.

worked: reuse before composition before creation reduced admissions from 55 to 15
hidden qualification and isolated registries prevented production mutation
later windows saturated with no new capability creation
did_not_work: naive growth admitted one zero-use capability per admission
strong abstraction decisions increased cost and growth debt without improving success
